commit.message:
[release-13.0.1] Dashboard: Preserve timezone user-preference when converting V1 → V2 (#122673)

Dashboard: Preserve timezone user-preference when converting V1 → V2 (#122267)

fix(dashboard): preserve timezone user-preference when converting V1 → V2

In V1/V0 dashboards, `timezone: ""` is the sentinel value meaning
"fall back to the user's profile preference". The V1→V2alpha1 converter
was initialising TimeSettings.Timezone from the spec default ("browser")
and then, for `timezone: ""`, leaving that default in place rather than
clearing it. As a result, every V0/V1 dashboard whose timezone was unset
would resolve to browser time in V2 instead of honouring the user's
profile setting.

Fix: when the V1 payload contains `timezone: ""` explicitly, set
TimeSettings.Timezone to nil so the serving layer can apply the
user-preference fallback, matching the V1 semantics. An absent timezone
key continues to use the "browser" default.

Regenerate golden checksums to reflect the corrected output (timezone
field omitted instead of being set to "").

(cherry picked from commit aae908bebc01865410c4345a2fe32a2a6ece303b)
